# Intro

Step 1 of candidate marker approach. Identify proteins w/in HPA annotated as secreted to blood.

The secreted to blood tag is a prediction. HPA also identifies proteins that have actually been "detected in blood by immunoassays," ([Uhlen 2019](https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/scisignal.aaz0274)). I am going to add this as a flag to differeniate between the two but allow all to proceed through the analysis.

Input was taken from HPA download page. Entire database was downloaded so it must be filtered.

# Settings

```{r}
hpa_file <- "data/raw/proteinatlas.tsv"
keep_location <- "Secreted to blood" # value of the "Secretome location" column to keep
out_file <- "data/processed/hpa_secreted_to_blood.rds"
```

# Load packages

```{r}
library(data.table)
```

# Import data

```{r}
hpa <- fread(hpa_file)
nrow(hpa) # genes
table(hpa[["Secretome location"]], useNA = "ifany") # blank = not predicted secreted
```

# Secreted to blood

```{r}
sec <- hpa[`Secretome location` == keep_location,
           .(gene = Gene, ensembl = Ensembl, description = `Gene description`,
             secretome_function = `Secretome function`,
             conc_IM = `Blood concentration - Conc. blood IM [pg/L]`,
             conc_MS = `Blood concentration - Conc. blood MS [pg/L]`)]
nrow(sec)
```

## Measured in blood flag

```{r}
sec[, measured_in_blood := "no"]
sec[!is.na(conc_MS), measured_in_blood := "mass spec"]
sec[!is.na(conc_IM), measured_in_blood := "immunoassay"]
sec[!is.na(conc_IM) & !is.na(conc_MS), measured_in_blood := "both"]
table(sec$measured_in_blood)
```

```{r}
head(sort(table(sec$secretome_function), decreasing = TRUE), 15)
```

# Save

```{r}
saveRDS(sec, out_file)
```
